messages:
emily: Hey team — Benson (paid customer) opened a ticket: their SSE streams disconnect intermittently and when they reconnect they sometimes see duplicated partial outputs and a big spike in billing usage. They say it started after yesterday's edge proxy patch. Posting their repro here so we can triage quickly.

benson-cust: Repro steps I used (from my mac):
```
# keep this open, you'll see it fail in ~45-60s
curl -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" -N -v \
  \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-medium&stream=true\"
```
Output pattern: stream sends a few events, then I get a TCP RST, curl exits, then I reconnect and the server replays the last ~3 events (duplicates). Each reconnect also shows a new billing charge for ~0.5s of tokens.

benson-cust: I can share packet capture if needed. Observed with their mobile SDK and raw curl.

emily: Thanks, can you attach pcap and sample request/response bodies? Also confirm SDK version.

benson-cust: Sent pcap to support@ — sdk v1.4.2 (mobile).

raj: Looking. Initial hypothesis: mismatch between comment-style pings (SSE `: comment` sent by client) and the edge proxy TCP keepalive / idle timeout. If proxy terminates idle TLS session without sending FIN to upstream we can end up with half-open connections where the client thinks it's connected, retries, and the runtime sees a resumed request and replays cached events. Also possible we aren't deduping resume tokens correctly on reconnects.

marta: Edge proxy (nginx-like) got the 2026-03-14 small change that lowered the idle_timeout from 120s to 60s for certain routes (rollout flag). I'll check logs for this customer's IP.

raj: Can you repro locally with a short idle timeout? I'll try to reproduce with an env var override: STREAM_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL=25 STREAM_PROXY_IDLE=60. If I can get deterministic repro I can instrument the runtime to detect duplicates.

cheng: Billing note — customer was charged 0.5s tokens twice, total ~0.0012 USD extra per incident, reported as "unexpected charges". We need to correlate billing_id for each connection and see why dedupe didn't fire. Might be because reconnect creates a new session id before resume token is validated.

ops-bot: collect-trace started for trace_id=trc_20260314_001 — capturing edge proxy + runtime spans for IP 52.41.23.45

deploy-bot: rollout flag edge.proxy.idle_timeout=60 -> 120 scheduled (canary to 10% immediate).

raj: Repro log snippet from my local run (simulating mobile SDK using small pings):
```
[stream] client_conn=abc123 msg=\": ping\n\"
[edge] closed idle conn (timeout=60) client_conn=abc123
[stream] new_conn=def456 resume_token=tok_xyz
[stream] replayed_events count=3 for resume_token=tok_xyz
[billing] charge session=def456 tokens=12 amount_usd=0.0012
```
Note the runtime accepted resume_token tok_xyz and replayed the last events; no dedupe happened because session id changed.

marta: Edge logs show several connections from that customer where upstream returned "writev: broken pipe" shortly before the proxy closed the TCP. The proxy sends a `GOAWAY`? No — this is plain TLS with keepalive. I'll dump the exact proxy message sequence.

emily: Customer asked for workaround — they can enable an application-level ping every 20s instead of relying on OS TCP keepalive. Does that make sense to recommend? Also they asked if rolling back yesterday's patch helps.

raj: Workaround yes: send an SSE comment ping `: 
` every 20s (client should send an HTTP-level ping by opening a second lightweight request or by keeping the existing connection active with a small POST? For SSE, clients usually rely on server pings; but mobile SDK can be configured to emit comment pings). However that is awkward. Better long-term fix: make resume semantics idempotent (dedupe by resume_token and last_event_id) and have the runtime detect half-open connections (TCP RST vs idle close) to avoid double-charging.

marta: Rolling back the edge patch will restore idle_timeout 120s and likely reduce occurrences. I can flip the rollout flag to 0% right now for this route. If that reduces incidents we can treat the change as root cause.

raj: Also adding a server-side last-seen-event map keyed by resume_token + model+customer with a short TTL (2 minutes) so that if a new session claims the same resume_token within window we suppress duplicate billing and avoid replaying identical events. That will help until we fix connection-level detection.

cheng: For support messaging — propose we: 1) Ask Benson to enable SDK-level comment pings (20s) as a short-term workaround. 2) Offer to rollback the edge change for their region and monitor. 3) If they want we can issue a small invoice credit for the duplicated charges while we investigate. Thoughts?

emily: Sounds good. I'll offer credit and rollback option. Benson is on dedicated plan so we should prioritize.

benson-cust: Thanks — will enable comment pings and confirm. Appreciate the credit offer.

raj: Action items assigned: raj -> instrument runtime to detect duplicate resume_token replay + add metric `stream.replay.dedupe` (low risk). marta -> pause/rollback edge idle timeout rollout for SSE route and share logs. emily/cheng -> customer comms + provisional credit. deploy-bot -> include trace_id trc_20260314_001 into the triage ticket.

ops-bot: tracing: collected 3 spans: edge.proxy -> tls_session -> runtime.stream (attached to trace_id).

marta: rolled back rollout to 0% at 2026-03-14T20:12:03Z for route /v1/streams; monitoring for errors. Initial drop in incidents for canary customers.

raj: I'll follow up with a short PR for idempotent resume handling and a follow-up changelog entry about recommended SDK behavior (comment pings).

emily: Closing loop with Benson later today. Will post update when they confirm workaround. @cheng please hold credit until we confirm duplicate billing pattern in logs.

benson-cust: Workaround confirmed — after enabling 20s pings no disconnects in 3 hours. Will update if it recurs. Thanks all! :heart: 

emily: Thanks all — moving to resolved for now, re-open if Benson sees recurrence.
